terms.title: Invented studio website handoff
terms.description: Invented sandbox project: design a single-page website for a small independent studio. Deliver a wireframe first, then a final handoff. No real customer data.

milestones.title: Wireframe Review
milestones.acceptance: Desktop wireframe includes labelled introduction, services and contact sections. Buyer checks all three sections before accepting.

milestones.title: Design Delivery
milestones.acceptance: Desktop and 390px mobile layouts, an editable design file, and a handoff note listing type, colors and spacing. Buyer checks each named item.
